steps.title: Welcome to Cask Lounge
steps.body: Your digital whisky companion: discover, rate, collect and share with friends. Here's a quick tour of everything you can do.

steps.title: Discover & ranking
steps.body: On the Global page you'll find every whisky, search them and filter by region. Each one shows the community average – tap it for the full details.

steps.title: Rate like a pro
steps.body: Rate colour, nose, taste and finish, pick aromas on the aroma wheel and jot down price & thoughts. Share publicly or keep it private – your call.

steps.title: Collection & wishlist
steps.body: Every rating lands in your collection automatically. Whiskies you still want to try go on your wishlist, so you never forget one.

steps.title: Map & compare
steps.body: See the distilleries in your collection on a world map – from Islay to Japan. And put two whiskies head to head in a direct comparison (⚖️).

steps.title: Groups & live sessions
steps.body: Join a group by code or link, or start your own. Share live what you're drinking, react with emojis and comment. Switch groups any time via the name at the top.

steps.title: Tastings & battles
steps.body: Inside groups you can run shared tastings and pit whiskies against each other in a battle (⚔️) – which one gets the most votes?

steps.title: It all starts with the plus
steps.body: Use the ➕ button to post live, add new whiskies or create a tasting. Navigate between Global, Collection, Groups and Profile along the bottom.
